title: Media storage policy and disk reserve

ownerDecision.decisionEvidence: Owner selected variant A: Git LFS for existing legacy original/provenance images during KIBER-49 closure.

diskReserve.cleanupBoundary: No broad Docker/server cleanup was performed because shared server cleanup can affect non-Alex services and requires separate operator approval.

runtimePublicMedia.sourceRule: Runtime pages must reference optimized public assets only, not site-export originals.

reviewOriginals.workingTreeAvailability: Originals remain available at normal paths for review/provenance while the Git index stores LFS pointers.

incomingDrops.migrationRule: New original/raw drops stay out of ordinary Git unless explicitly optimized into public runtime media or migrated to Git LFS.

dockerContext.rule: Review originals and incoming drops must not enter runtime Docker context.
